answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake behind a beacon credential that only matures after a slow, verifiable work season: the stake is a dune that shifts slowly, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs real capital and weeks of waiting, while honest agents earn the deposit back with interest. A glacier-slow decay then erases dormant credentials, so an attacker must keep paying to keep each fake alive, making a Sybil flood cost more than it can ever extract.
